description: This file implements the SetLogLevelsService class, which manages client connections and sets log levels for connected clients via IPC events.

classes.name: SetLogLevelsService
classes.description: A service class that manages IPC clients and sets log levels across connected clients.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection by adding it to the set of connected clients.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection by removing it from the set of connected clients.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets log levels for all connected clients by creating and sending a SetLogLevelsEvent.
